intent: Generalize the compiled verification check list into a named registry with repository defaults and ticket-declared extras, so gate checks run in every verification without agent discipline.

requirements.REQ-VC-A: A named check registry maps every non-structural contract check to a subprocess command run in the candidate worktree, including the Godot boundary gate under the root godot.toml convention for game-project tickets, and compilation rejects tickets that declare unknown or structural check names.
requirements.REQ-VC-B: Every compiled contract for this repository includes the documentation gate check by default, so verification fails on a stale generated catalog or an unresolved documentation pointer in the candidate.
requirements.REQ-VC-C: The charter records that L2 gates are wired into compiled verification checks and documents the frozen handoff brief's exemption from the pointer gate.
